crosshair.caveat: CrossHair absence-of-counterexample is NOT a proof. Combined with the exhaustive finite enumeration (z3-agreeing) over the seeded domain, the helper is verified over its bounded domain.

assumptions: KernelLanguage is fixed to 'Assembly' (the only valid value, ValidParameters.py:915), so states.scheduleIterAlg = kernel['_ScheduleIterAlg']. For SIA in {0,1,3} (SIA != 4), _ScheduleIterAlg == ScheduleIterAlg (Solution.py:587-602). ScheduleIterAlg==4 (StinkyTofu) is excluded from the domain because it maps _ScheduleIterAlg->0 only via rocisa hardware-capability probes (a GPU/ISA-dependent sub-path); value 2 omitted to keep the domain at 3 elements.

NLLlast is the param NLLlast passed into _makeSubIterSchedule from noLoadLoop (KernelWriter.py:3522). It is NOT a direct YAML input: it starts True and is forced False only when PrefetchGlobalRead>=2 AND isNGLL (the NoGlobalLoadLoop pass). isNGLL is a call-site control flag, so for a fully-static (YAML-only) characterization it is an internal unknown bounded to {False,True}; the solver treats it as a free Boolean within its domain.

tailloopInNll (param) == self.states.tailloopInNll == YAML TailloopInNll (KernelWriter.py:6208), possibly overridden to False upstream (Solution.py:3864) if prerequisites fail; the predicate truth value here is computed from the value actually delivered to the function.

Path C (ScheduleIterAlg==4 -> _ScheduleIterAlg=0) reaches the True branch but depends on rocisa.hasStinkyTofuBackend()/isSupportedByStinkyTofu(ISA); excluded from the solved domain as runtime/ISA-dependent.
notes: solver-backed-under-assumptions: the predicate is a pure boolean/integer function of public YAML inputs (ScheduleIterAlg, TailloopInNll) PLUS one internal call-site flag (NLLlast, derived from PrefetchGlobalRead and the isNGLL pass flag). z3 produced real sat models for both polarities; exhaustive enumeration over the seeded domain agrees and CrossHair found no counterexample to the extracted pure helper. It is NOT fully-static because NLLlast depends on isNGLL, an internal noLoadLoop pass flag not expressible purely from YAML; under the assumption that isNGLL ranges over {False,True} the branch is fully solved. The ScheduleIterAlg==4 StinkyTofu route to the True branch is genuinely runtime/ISA-dependent and is held out of the domain.
